title: Germany – Electrical fitting work – Schnieglinger Str. 71 (147a) - Krematorium, Ofensanierung, 053.02 Elektrotechnik
description: 1. Gegenstand der ausgeschriebenen Leistung: Im Rahmen der Sanierung des Krematoriums Nürnberg, Westfriedhof, ist es erforderlich das Technikgebäude baulich zu erweitern. Dabei wird das Bestandsgebäude des Krematoriums saniert und umgebaut, sowie mit gleicher Traufhöhe erweitert. Die Erweiterung erfolgt in westlicher Richtung, damit maximal entfernt von dem historischen denkmalgeschützten Bestandsgebäudeteilen. Die vorliegende Ausschreibung umfasst Gerüstbauarbeiten. Als wichtige Randbedingung ist zu benennen, dass die Ausführung des Vorhabens in insgesamt fünf Bauphasen untergliedert ist und der Umbau/die Sanierung, sowie Erweiterung IM LAUFENDEN BETRIEB erfolgen müssen. Die Maßnahme umfasst abschnittsweise Bauleistungen, welche zum Teil komplexe Schnittstellen zur technischen Ausrüstung und zum Anlagenbau der Kremationsanlagen aufweisen. Ein Großteil der Gewerke und Leistungsbereiche wiederholt sich in den einzelnen Bauphasen.

title: Core Research Program Technology Transfer & Commercialization Advancement
description: The Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA) Research and Development (R&D) Core Research Program announces this competitive solicitation for proposals focused strictly on Technology Transfer (T2) and Commercialization Advancement. The core objective of this Research Announcement is to accelerate the transition of high-impact pipeline safety innovations from advanced laboratory and operational prototypes to full-scale commercial deployment and operational field implementation across the Nation's energy transportation infrastructure. This solicitation specifically targets mature technologies at high Technology Readiness Levels (TRL 7�9) to bridge the critical 'implementation gap' by resolving final technical, regulatory, operational, credentialing, and market hurdles. Funding will only be awarded for projects that demonstrate a clear, definitive path to producing deployable technology, commercial products, or integrated service system ready for immediate market availability and pipeline operator adoption upon project completion.

title: G003--Mega Bus Retreat - Readjustment Counseling Services 36C256-27-AP-0943 POC: Luke Miles
description: SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE Readjustment Counseling Service (RCS) Group Retreat Program Market Research Only Not a Solicitation Notice ID: 36C25627Q0120 NAICS Code: 561599 PSC: G003 Response Due Date: November 16, 2026, at 4:00 PM CST Contracting Activity: Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), NCO-16, Commercial Acquisition Team New Orleans 1. Purpose This is a Sources Sought Notice issued solely for information and planning purposes. This notice is being used by the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) to identify qualified sources capable of providing comprehensive retreat services for eligible Vet Center clients under the Readjustment Counseling Service (RCS) retreat program. This announcement is not a Solicitation, Request for Proposal (RFP), Request for Quotation (RFQ), or Invitation for Bid (IFB). Responses to this notice are for market research purposes only and will be used by the Government to determine the availability of qualified sources and the appropriate acquisition strategy, including whether a socioeconomic set-aside is appropriate. The Government does not intend to award a contract based on this notice and will not reimburse any costs incurred in responding. 2. Requirement Overview The VA Readjustment Counseling Service anticipates a requirement for a contractor to develop, coordinate, and execute group retreat events designed to augment readjustment counseling services for eligible Vet Center clients. The retreat program is intended to provide a structured, supportive environment for Veterans and other eligible participants experiencing challenges associated with combat exposure, military service, military sexual trauma, and related reintegration issues. The contractor shall provide a turnkey solution that includes program development, staffing, travel coordination, lodging, meals, transportation, supplies, equipment, activity facilitation, and outcome reporting. Anticipated Scope The contractor shall provide: A minimum of three (3) retreat events during a one-year performance period. Retreats accommodating up to twenty (20) participants per event. Four- to six-day retreat events, including participant travel days. At least one women Veterans-only retreat during the performance period. Retreat locations within or accessible to RCS Continental District 4, consisting of: Texas Louisiana Arkansas Mississippi Wyoming Utah Colorado Kansas Missouri Nebraska Program Elements Retreat activities may include: Reintegration into family, employment, and community settings. Financial counseling and education. Occupational counseling and career assessments. Stress reduction techniques and resilience-building activities. Conflict resolution education and skill development. Team-building and experiential outdoor activities. Contractor Responsibilities The contractor shall be capable of providing: Retreat planning and administration. Qualified facilitators and support personnel. Mental Health First Aid support. Travel arrangements for participants. ADA-compliant transportation and accommodations. Lodging and meals. Appropriate retreat facilities and equipment. Safety and emergency support capabilities. Participant evaluation and outcome reporting. Compliance with applicable privacy and confidentiality requirements. 3. Desired Capabilities Interested firms should demonstrate experience and capability in the following areas: Planning and conducting multi-day retreat programs for Veteran, military, family, behavioral health, or similar populations. Managing all logistics associated with participant travel, lodging, transportation, meals, and program execution. Providing experiential, educational, or therapeutic group programming. Supporting participants with accessibility and accommodation needs. Employing staff with appropriate certifications, such as: Mental Health First Aid CPR/First Aid Wilderness First Responder (when applicable) Conducting activities in a safe and structured environment utilizing recognized industry standards and risk-management practices. Measuring participant outcomes and customer satisfaction. Coordinating with federal personnel supporting retreat operations. 4. Information Requested Interested firms are requested to submit a capability statement containing the following information: Company Information Business name Address UEI CAGE Code Point of contact Telephone number Email address Website address Business Status Identify all applicable business categories: Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Veteran-Owned Small Business (VOSB) Small Business HUBZone Small Business 8(a) Small Business Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) Economically Disadvantaged Woman-Owned Small Business (EDWOSB) Other socioeconomic designation, if applicable If claiming SDVOSB or VOSB status, identify current SBA VetCert certification status. Relevant Experience Provide up to three contracts or projects completed within the last five years that are similar in scope and complexity. Include: Customer name Contract number (if applicable) Period of performance Dollar value Description of services provided Customer point of contact (if available) Technical Capability Describe your firm's ability to: Conduct multiple retreat events annually. Coordinate participant travel and logistics. Provide lodging and meal services. Support outdoor and experiential activities. Meet accessibility requirements. Conduct outcome assessments and reporting. Staffing Describe: Key personnel categories. Relevant certifications. Experience supporting Veteran populations. Geographic Coverage Identify the geographic areas where your firm currently operates and the locations where retreat services could be provided. Pricing Information Provide rough-order-of-magnitude pricing or commercial pricing methodology for planning purposes. Pricing information will be used for market research only and will not constitute an offer. Interest in Future Solicitation State whether your company would likely submit an offer as a prime contractor if the requirement were solicited as: SDVOSB Set-Aside VOSB Set-Aside Total Small Business Set-Aside Unrestricted Competition 5. Response Submission Responses should be limited to approximately 10-12 pages, excluding supporting certifications and past performance documentation. Submit responses electronically to: Luke Miles, Contract Specialist Email: luke.miles@va.gov Subject Line: Sources Sought Response RCS Group Retreat Services [Company Name] Responses must be received no later than: November 16, 2026, at 4:00 PM CST 6. Disclaimer This Sources Sought Notice is issued for market research purposes only and does not constitute a commitment, implied or otherwise, that the Government will issue a solicitation or award a contract. The Government reserves the right to use the information received to determine the most appropriate acquisition strategy. Responses will not be returned and no reimbursement will be made for costs associated with responding to this notice. The Government may contact respondents for clarification or additional information as part of its market research efforts.

title: Core Research Program Technology Transfer & Commercialization Advancement
description: The Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA) Research and Development (R&D) Core Research Program announces this competitive solicitation for proposals focused strictly on Technology Transfer (T2) and Commercialization Advancement. The core objective of this Research Announcement is to accelerate the transition of high-impact pipeline safety innovations from advanced laboratory and operational prototypes to full-scale commercial deployment and operational field implementation across the Nation's energy transportation infrastructure. This solicitation specifically targets mature technologies at high Technology Readiness Levels (TRL 7�9) to bridge the critical 'implementation gap' by resolving final technical, regulatory, operational, credentialing, and market hurdles. Funding will only be awarded for projects that demonstrate a clear, definitive path to producing deployable technology, commercial products, or integrated service system ready for immediate market availability and pipeline operator adoption upon project completion.

title: Energy Automation Operational Technology Systems (EAOTS) Automated Fuel Handling Equipment Maintenance
description: This acquisition is for services supporting the maintenance and sustainment of the installed Automated Fuel Handling Equipment (AFHE) located at 23 designated places of performance worldwide, which includes providing all personnel, equipment, materials, maintenance Program Management, and services to perform the maintenance for the AFHE systems and implementing equipment installation at these sites. This effort consists of Preventive Maintenance, Corrective Maintenance, Site Support, SCADA Maintenance, Support Documentation, Meter System Calibration, and Equipment and Material Support. All services including labor, equipment, materials, parts, tools, test equipment, transportation, and travel for maintaining and repairing equipment associated with the AFHE systems are encompassed under this effort; to include all services in support of design, procurement, installation, testing, subsystem/system implementation, system interfaces, training, documentation generation, integration and system troubleshooting of installations/modifications to the AFHE system. This effort will require the Contractor to have the capability to respond to multiple requests simultaneously and to work at multiple locations worldwide. The Government is anticipating award of a five (5) year Firm-Fixed Price IDIQ contract that will consist of Transition In, Maintenance Program Management, Preventive Maintenance, Corrective Maintenance, Site Support Projects, and Transition Out contract line items. If you are interested in receiving a draft PWS, please email the contact persons on this posting.

title: CVN 75 RCOH Painting, Decking and Lagging
description: DISCLOSURE: This is a Request for Information (RFI) notice only. This is not a Request for Proposal (RFP) and a formal solicitation is not available at this time. This RFI is for informational planning purposes and it is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government to issue an RFP, contract, or order for any actual procurement of materials, machinery, supply or service. The Government will not pay for any effort expended or any material provided in response to this announcement. All costs associated with responding to this RFI are solely at the responding parties' expense. Responses to this notice are not offers and will not be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract or agreement. The Government will not be obligated to pursue any particular acquisition alternative because of this RFI. Responses to the RFI will not be returned. Not responding to this RFI does not preclude participation in any future solicitation, if one is issued. Specific responses to the approaches will not disqualify or have an impact on participation and evaluation on future solicitations. No specific information is required in response to this RFI; however, interested parties may respond and indicate interest as desired. PURPOSE: This RFI is in support of market research being conducted by the PAE Maritime, Aircraft Carriers Program Office (PMS 312). The purpose of this Sources Sought is to solicit input via capability and experience statements from interested parties with the capabilities necessary to provide professional shipboard preservation, painting, decking, and lagging services. This contract covers the mobilization, surface preparation, application of specialized marine/facility coatings, deck installation, and thermal insulation (lagging) during the USS HARRY S. TRUMAN (CVN 75) Refueling Complex Overhaul (RCOH) availability. The work will be performed at Huntington Ingalls Industries-Newport News Shipbuilding�s (HII-NNS) facility. The anticipated scope of work will cover three primary disciplines: Preservation & Painting: Surface preparation (SSPC-SP3/SP10 mechanical cleaning or water blasting), primer application, and marine-grade epoxy finish coats on designated structures. Decking Installation: Underlayment preparation, leveling, and installation of non-skid, cosmetic, or standard commercial-grade decking systems. Lagging & Insulation: Removal of damaged insulation, and the subsequent fabrication and installation of pipe lagging, thermal blankets, and protective glass cloth jackets. REQUEST FOR INFORMATION: It is with the above understanding that DPAE Carriers and PMS 312 seeks responses from industry base on the information below:?? DPAE Carriers/PMS 312 seeks businesses who can support and/or provide the following owned or leased, but not limited to:? Facilities and storage locations? Equipment owned or leased? Paint labor and purchasing? Safety equipment? Training? Stock and non-stock material purchases? Service material? Alteration Installation Team (AIT) support? Professional support services? Engineering Services? Facility Management? Has your company provided support (prime or subcontracted) to DPAE Carriers in the past? If so, please provide contract number and summary of the work provided.? Please provide the following: Technical Capability Statement: Brief description of the firm's experience with marine or commercial painting, decking, and lagging projects within the last 3 years. Certifications: Proof of relevant quality standards (e.g., SSPC-QP1/QP2 for painting, or general ISO 9001/14001 Quality Management systems). Please ensure your response includes the following information: 1) organization name, point of contact, address, email address, website address, telephone number, size and type of ownership for the organization; and 2) tailored capability statements addressing the particulars of this effort including any limitations or concerns; 3) if significant subcontracting or teaming is anticipated in order to deliver technical capability, briefly address the administrative and management structure of such arrangements; and 4) if your company has an approved cost accounting system. SUBMISSION DETAILS: Responses and comments are requested by 1700 EST, on 16 November 2026. However, submissions will be accepted after this date, but feedback may not be as timely or contribute to PAE Maritime�s strategic planning process. Information should be e-mailed to Jim McGowan (james.f.mcgowan6.civ@us.navy.mil) and Angela Garais (angela.c.garais.civ@us.navy.mil). The Government is not obligated to respond to any or all questions or comments submitted in response to this RFI or information provided as a result of this request, but, the Navy will consider each question or comment received when making plans for the program or future information to be shared. Responses are requested to be provided electronically, with no less than 10-point font and acceptable formats include Adobe PDF, Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft PowerPoint files. It is requested that there be a cover sheet with a one-page executive summary of the response and include the company details as well as the names, position title, city, state, phone and e-mail address of the subject matter experts who contributed to the response and the primary point of contact. The information provided will assist PAE Maritime in future developments, procurements, and acquisitions. Since DPAE Carriers includes Navy employees, Government support contractors, and participating new ship construction shipyards, the responses and comments provided should be segregated and labeled any proprietary information contained; and that portion will be treated as Business Sensitive and will not be shared with non-Government employees without the permission of the provider. Please clearly delineate in your responses any data that is shareable only with the U.S. Navy personnel and what can be shared with Navy support contractors and/or ship construction shipyards. Partial responses to this RFI are encouraged; a respondent need not respond to all questions for their responses to be considered. Follow-up questions may be asked of responders for clarification, but this will not indicate a selection or preference. Responders are advised that the U.S. Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this RFI. Not responding to this RFI does not preclude participation in any future RFP or other solicitation, if any is issued. Classified material will not be accepted.

title: Y1DZ--598-22-115 Site Utility Infrastructure-NLR
description: This procurement will be issued as a 100% Set-Aside for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSB) through RFP procedures under FAR 15. The Central Arkansas Veterans Healthcare System (CAVHS) has a requirement Upgrade/Replace Site Utility Infrastructure, Project #598-22-115. The tentative date for issuing the RFP is on or around November 17, 2026, with proposals due approximately 49 calendar days later on or around January 05, 2027. There will be no public bid opening. The period of performance is 720 calendar days after issuance of the Notice to Proceed. Location of the work is at the Eugene J. Towbin (EJT) VA Healthcare Center, 2200 Fort Roots Drive, North Little Rock, AR 72114. The point of contact for this notice is Contract Specialist, Julius Jones at Julius.Jones@va.gov.Telephone requests will NOT be accepted. Abbreviated Scope of Work: The scope of this project includes upgrading the water source, storage, and site distribution system at the North Little Rock (NLR) Veterans Affairs Medical Center (VAMC) campus: All work shall be done is a manner and sequence to minimize impact to the campus, patients, visitors and staff. No prolonged outages are permitted and any activity affecting the campus shall be coordinated in advance. See additional sections for detailed information. The NLR campus is short of reserve water capacity. This project includes a new elevated water storage tank. The new tank installation shall include all labor and materials required for a complete and operational system including, but not limited to, supporting structure, piping, appurtenances, and accessories as required. The existing elevated 250,000-gallon water tower shall be demolished in its entirety including all below grade supporting structure, piping vaults, etc. The demolition shall be in strict accordance with the phasing schedule. A new pump house with new pumps and new pump controls is included in this project. Physical and operational security, monitoring, controls, redundancy and emergency power are included. The new pump house installation shall include all labor and materials required for a complete and operational system including, but not limited to, structure, fence, paving, piping, cameras, access control, emergency generator, appurtenances, and accessories as required. A new automated control system that interlocks to and also controls the existing south pump house as well as the new north pump house is included in this project. The new system shall be seamlessly integrated into the existing automation system currently operating the south pump house. This project also replaces all existing, failing cast iron, ductile iron, galvanized, asbestos cement, and/or any other material water pipe with new pipe as shown on the project plans. The water supply lines are generally looped to improve supply redundancy and improve the water pressure. Additionally, new backflow preventers shall be installed on the Fire Protection supply lines to buildings which have fire protection systems. This installation will include pressure testing, disinfecting, and hyper-chlorinating as required for new piping installation per Federal, State, and Local codes. Multiple phases are required and part of the project. 237110 Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction is applicable to the RFP, and the Small Business Size Standard is $45M. A 90-day proposal acceptance period will be required. A bid bond must be submitted with the proposal. Performance and Payment bonds will be required from the contractor receiving the award.The magnitude of construction is between $20,000,000 and $50,000,000. Interested offerors are asked to first read over the RFP and all its associated attachments/documents in their entirety prior to forwarding any questions to the Contracting Officer. A cut-off time/date for receipt of questions will be established and listed in the RFP, as well as a time/date for the scheduled Site Visit. Only one Site Visit will be conducted and no requests for additional Site visits or make-up Site Visits will be granted. The RFP number for this project is 36C25626R0084. The RFP will be posted and can be downloaded (without charge) from the SAM.gov website. Amendments to the RFP will not be mailed but will be posted at the SAM.gov website. Offerors are responsible for obtaining the RFP (and associated documents/attachments) from the SAM.gov website and for acknowledging all amendments to the RFP. It is the responsibility of all interested offerors to check the SAM.gov website as necessary for any Amendments to the RFP (to include the day bids are due). In accordance with VAAR 819.7003 Eligibility, at the time of submission of a proposal, the offeror must represent to the Contracting Officer that it is a SDVOSB concern, that it is a small business concern under the NAICS Code assigned to the acquisition, and that it is verified for eligibility in the Small Business Association website (Veteran Small Business Certification (VetCert)) and have the Veterans Small Business Certification. SDVOSB concerns must also be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) database at www.sam.gov. DISCLAIMER: This Pre-solicitation Notification is NOT a Solicitation. In accordance with FAR 15.201(e), responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. Any liability associated with the submission of information in response to this notice is the responsibility of the submitting contractor. The Government shall not be held responsible or liable for any information submitted, or for any costs associated with the submitted information.

title: W044--Temporary boiler Rental & Maintenance
description: INTENT TO SOLE SOURCE THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION OR REQUEST FOR OFFERS. NO SOLICITATION PACKAGE IS AVAILABLE NOR WILL TELEPHONE REQUESTS BE HONORED. NO SOLICITATION WILL BE POSTED TO CONTRACT OPPORTUNITIES. PROCUREMENT TITLE: Temporary Boiler Rental and Maintenance INTENT TO AWARD: The Department of Veterans Affairs (NCO 19), 6162 S. Willow Drive, Greenwood Village, CO 80111, intends to award one (1) Procurement on a Sole Source basis, to Ivan Ware & Son, LLC dba Ware, for temporary boiler rental and maintenance. BACKGROUND AND DESCRIPTION: This procurement is for the continued rental of two Ware mobile boilers, to include maintenance, services, inspection, and testing per Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), Boiler Efficiency Institute (BEI), and Veterans Affairs (VA) standards, as well as the rental of one control room trailer. These mobile boilers and control room will continue to serve as the temporary boiler plant for the duration of the construction and commissioning of the permanent boiler plant. Ware mobile boilers are currently on site and functional, and to remove them would endanger the Facility s ability to provide steam to the Main Hospital. Steam is required to maintain operational status of the hospital functions including surgeries, sterilization, cooking, and heating. The current VA boilers are 11 years past their operational life space and are in the process of being replaced. Temporary boilers are the only means to maintain hospital operations during this boiler plant construction project. The mobile boilers fill a Veteran s Health Administration (VHA) requirement to maintain N+1 on boiler capacity to reduce the risk of ever being without steam. There is no way to maintain steam production with the current plant during the boiler plant construction project. These mobile boilers and control trailer are needed until the completion and commissioning of the newly constructed permanent boiler plant. NAICS: 532490 Other Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment Rental and Leasing, $40 Million PSC: W044 Lease or Rental of Equipment Furnace, Steam Plant, and Drying Equipment; Nuclear Reactors AUTHORITY: This procurement will be issued under the authority of RFO Part 12 Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed award upon response to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Contracting Officer. Interested parties may identify their interest and capability to respond to this requirement as described in the attached Statement of Work no later than 3:00 PM Mountain Standard Time, Monday, November 16th, 2026. Responses to this notice are to be sent to heather.chase2@va.gov. A determination not to compete this requirement, based upon responses to this notice, is solely within the discretion of the Government. The Government is not responsible for any potential costs incurred from interested parties desiring to respond to this notice. ATTACHED: Statement of Work

description: Předběžná tržní konzultace (PTK) k VZ: "Dodávka detektorů chemických látek", jejímž cílem je zjištění okruhu potenciálních dodavatelů a získání informací od dodavatelů působících na relevantním trhu pro správné nastavení zadávacích podmínek. Zadavatel má zájem, aby zadávací podmínky co nejlépe odpovídaly jeho potřebám a současně, aby byly i spolu s předmětem zakázky nastaveny v souladu se zákonem č. 134/2016 Sb., o zadávání veřejných zakázek, ve znění pozdějších předpisů (dále také jen „ZZVZ“). Zadavatel realizací předběžné tržní konzultace hodlá předcházet možným rizikům, která by se při zadávání veřejné zakázky a jejím následném plnění mohla vyskytnout. Zadavatel chce v rámci předběžné tržní konzultace získat informace o možnostech relevantního trhu tak, aby mohl optimálně nastavit zadávací podmínky veřejné zakázky, resp. celého zadávacího řízení na dodávku detektorů chemických látek. Předpokládaná hodnota veřejné zakázky dosud není známa. V případě Vašeho zájmu o účast na této předběžné tržní konzultaci prosím zašlete své odpovědi na dotazy uvedené v příloze č. 1 pozvánky PTK na e-mailovou adresu zástupce zadavatele: zakazky@matznervitek.cz Svoji odpověď prosím doručte nejpozději do pondělí 16. 11. 2026, 23:59 hod.

description: In absehbarer Zukunft werden die Kreiskliniken des Landkreises Lörrach und das St.Elisabethen-Krankenhaus im neuen Zentralklinikum Lörrach (Dreiland-Klinikum- Lörrach), im Nordosten der Stadt vereint. In diesem Zusammenhang wird auch der Standort des Kreiskrankenhauses in Lörrach aufgegeben. Das ca. 3,5 ha große innenstadtnahe Areal zwischen der Röntgenstraße im Süden, der Spitalstraße im Osten, der Körnerstraße im Norden und dem Gewerbekanal „Neuer Teich“ im Westen, wird an die Stadt Lörrach zurückfallen und für eine Folgenutzung frei. Das Krankenhaus-Areal ist einer der wichtigen Transformationsorte der Stadt und im Kontext mit der Weiterentwicklung der Gesamtstadt zu sehen. Die Entwicklung des Areals soll dementsprechend im Kontext der Stärkung Lörrachs als urbane und lebenswerte Stadt in der Region verstanden werden. Ziel ist es, mutige, innovative und unkonventionelle Entwurfsansätze zu entwickeln, die den gegenwärtigen Städtebau hinterfragen und eine auf Lörrach zugeschnittene neue Urbanität schaffen, die Klimaanpassung mit Nutzungsmischung, soziale Teilhabe und Mehrgenerationenfähigkeit konsequent und resilient umsetzt. Das künftige Areal soll unter möglicher Berücksichtigung des Teilerhalts vorhandener Strukturen und der Umnutzung einiger potenzieller Gebäudeteile als urbanes Quartier neu überplant werden. Ziel ist es, ein zukunftsfähiges Quartier zu schaffen und zusätzlich eine Perspektive für die Weiterentwicklung der unmittelbaren Umgebung und angrenzender Gebiete vor-zubereiten. Die städtebauliche und freiraumplanerische Transformation des Areals, in Etappen und langfristig, ermöglicht ein innenstadtnahes durchmischtes Quartier mit dem Schwerpunkt auf Wohnen und Nutzungen der Gesundheitsvorsorge, Erholung sowie sozialer und gewerblicher Infrastruktur und vereint eine angemessene zukunftsorientiere Dichte mit innerstädtischen Freiräumen und Klimaanpassung. Wettbewerbsgegenstand: Städtebaulich-freiraumplanerische Vorentwurfsplanung (Leistungsphase 2) für das künftige urbane Quartier in Lörrach. Wettbewerbsverfahren: Offener zweiphasiger städtebaulich-freiraumplanerischer Realisierungswettbewerb gemäß der RPW 2013, mit anschließendem Verhandlungsverfahren nach der VgV. Die Beurteilung und Auswahl der Teilnehmer*innen in der ersten Phase, die für die Bearbeitung des städtebaulich-freiraumplanerischen Realisierungswettbewerb (2. Phase) zugelassen werden, erfolgt anhand einer „Kreativaufgabe“ durch das Preisgericht. Der Wettbewerb wird im Rahmen der VgV 2016, i.V.m. § 3 Abs. 3 RPW 2013 durchgeführt und ist anonym (gemäß § 1 Abs. 4 der RPW 2013). Im Anschluss an das Wettbewerbsverfahren, nach Abschluss der 2. Phase, werden gemäß § 14 Abs. 4 Ziff. 8 VgV die Preisträger*innen zu Vergabeverhandlungsgesprächen eingeladen. Beauftragung: Die Ausloberin wird, unter Würdigung der Empfehlungen des Preisgerichts, eine*n der Preisträger*innen (§ 8 Abs. 2 RPW 2013) mit der Leistungsphase 3 des städtebaulichen Entwurfs und der Leistungsphase 3 des freiräumlichen Entwurfs beauftragen. Gemäß der Vergaberichtlinien nach VgV sind mit allen Preisträger*innen Verhandlungsgespräche zu führen. Rechtsgrundlage: Richtlinien 2014/24/EU VgV - Verordnung über die Vergabe öffentlicher Aufträge - Deutsch RPW 2013 - Richtlinie für Planungswettbewerbe - Deutsch Teilnahmeberechtigt sind: Natürliche Personen, die gemäß Rechtsvorschrift ihres Heimatlandes am Tag der Bekanntmachung zur Führung einer der folgenden Berufsbezeichnungen berechtigt sind (Richtlinie 2005/36/EG Berufsanerkennungsrichtlinie): Stadtplaner*in, Landschaftsarchitekt*in, Architekt*in. Interdisziplinäre Bewerber*innen oder interdisziplinäre Bewerbergemeinschaften, die die fachlichen Voraussetzungen erfüllen. Fachliche Voraussetzungen sind die Berechtigungen zur Führung der folgenden Berufsbezeichnungen gemäß Rechtsvorschrift des Herkunftsstaates: Stadtplaner*in, Landschaftsarchitekt*in, Architekt*in. Erfüllt ein*e Bewerber*in die fachliche Voraussetzung allein oder zusammen mit fest angestellten Mitarbeitern*innen ist er*sie allein teilnahmeberechtigt. (Der*die Mitarbeiter*in / die Mitarbeiter*innen ist / sind in der Verfassererklärung explizit zu nennen.) Bei juristischen Personen sind die fachlichen Anforderungen erfüllt, wenn der satzungsgemäße Geschäftszweck Planungsleistungen sind, die der Wettbewerbsaufgabe entsprechen. Außerdem muss der*die zu benennende bevollmächtigte Vertreter*in und der oder die Verfasser*innen der Wettbewerbsarbeit insgesamt die oben genannte fachliche Anforderung erfüllen. Ist in dem Herkunftsstaat die Berufsbezeichnung nicht gesetzlich geregelt, so erfüllt die entsprechende fachliche Anforderung, wer über ein Diplom, Prüfungszeugnis oder sonstigen Befähigungsnachweis verfügt, dessen Anerkennung gemäß der Richtlinie 2013/55/EU- „Berufsanerkennungsrichtlinie“ - gewährleistet ist. Mehrfachbeteiligungen natürlicher oder juristischer Personen oder von Mitgliedern von Bewerbergemeinschaften führen zum Ausschluss der Beteiligten. Teilnahmehindernisse sind in § 4 Abs. 2 RPW beschrieben. Sachverständige, Fachplaner*innen, Berater*innen müssen die Teilnahmebedingungen nicht erfüllen. Benennung Landschaftsarchitekt*in: Die Benennung des*der Landschaftsarchitekt*in muss bis zum Ende der Frist zur 1. Phase erfolgt sein (16.11.2026, 23:59 Uhr). Frist zur Einreichung der Bewerbung zur Teilnahme: 16.11.2026, 23:59 Uhr. title: Germany – Construction work – DSP - Pumpenhaus Scharnhorststraße Dezentral
description: Das Projekt DSP – Dezentral Scharnhorststraße Pumpenhaus ist eine Infrastrukturmaßnahme zur Erweiterung und Modernisierung des Heizwerks Scharnhorststraße. Am Standort Scharnhorststraße wird eine neue Wärmeübertragerstation mit zwei Pumpengruppen, Rohrleitungssystemen sowie den erforderlichen elektro- und leittechnischen Einrichtungen in einer „Brownfield-Umgebung“ errichtet. Die Umsetzung erfolgt innerhalb eines bestehenden Heizwerksstandortes in einer Brownfield-Umgebung. Neben der Errichtung neuer Anlagenkomponenten sind zahlreiche Schnittstellen zu bestehenden Anlagen, Rohrleitungssystemen, elektro- und leittechnischen Einrichtungen sowie betrieblichen Prozessen zu berücksichtigen. Besonderes Augenmerk liegt dabei auf der Aufrechterhaltung der Versorgungssicherheit und die Umsetzung aller relevanten Umschlussarbeiten innerhalb eines drei (3) monatigen Stillstandsfensters. Für die Umsetzung des Projektes werden in einem vorgelagerten Projekt bereits die erforderlichen Voraussetzungen zur Baufeldfreimachung geschaffen. Aufbauend darauf umfasst das Projekt DSP die Ausführungsplanung, Beschaffung, Errichtung, Inbetriebsetzung und Übergabe der neuen Anlagentechnik einschließlich aller hierfür erforderlichen Nebenleistungen. Auszuführende Arbeiten: • Montage und Umbau von Fernwärme-Anlagenkomponenten • Installation und Integration von Pumpensystemen mit elektrischer Antriebstechnik • Rohrleitungsbau für Fernwärmeanwendungen einschließlich Verbindung und Einbindung von Anlagenteilen (Nennweiten ca. DN 200 bis DN 600) • Anbindung neuer Rohrleitungen und Komponenten an bestehende Versorgungs- und Rohrleitungssysteme • Lieferung und Montage von Armaturen, Regel- und Absperreinrichtungen (Nennweiten ca. DN 250 bis DN 600) • Planung und Errichtung von Rohrleitungsbefestigungen sowie unterstützenden Stahlbaukonstruktionen • Einbindung bestehender Anlagenkomponenten in neu errichtete Systeme • Herstellung von Fundamenten für Anlagen- und Stahlbaukomponenten • Anpassung und Erweiterung von Niederspannungs-, Energieversorgungs- und Antriebssystemen • Anpassung und Erweiterung von Mess-, Steuerungs- und Leittechnik • Erneuerung elektrischer Energieversorgungsanlagen einschließlich Kabelverlegung • Demontage und Rückbau bestehender Anlagen- und Rohrleitungskomponenten (Nennweiten bis ca. DN 500) Die Anbindungen an das Netz erfolgen auf dem Betriebsgelände. Die oberirdische Zuführung der beiden DN500 Leitungen auf dem Betriebsgelände auf einem bestehenden Stahlbau gehört zum Projektumfang. Die vorhandene und zu erweiternde Leittechnik ist auf dem Betriebsgebäude verortet. Die Planung der E- und Leittechnik sind Bestandteil vom Projektumfang. Schnittstellen zur bestehenden E- und Leittechnik sind vorhanden und zu berücksichtigen.

title: Germany – Boiler installations – Neubeschaffung von zwei baugleichen Heißwassererzeuger für den Standort Köpenick
description: Wir verweisen hiermit auf die Ausschreibung Nr. 2026005415 die eine ähnliche Beschaffungsart aufweist. Am Standort des BHKW Köpenick müssen die beiden baugleichen Heißwassererzeugungsanlagen HWE 40 und HWE 50 gegen nahezu leistungsidentische Neuanlagen als Großwasserraumkesselausführung (nach EN 12953) ersetzt werden. Um die Versorgungssicherheit am Standort nicht zu gefährden bzw. nicht weiter einzuschränken ist ein schrittweises Vorgehen für den Ersatz von zuerst HWE 40 und nachfolgend von HWE 50 zwingend notwendig. Die beiden neu zu errichtenden Heißwassererzeuger sollen wieder unterhalb der Kesselhausdecke an die bestehenden Rauchgaskanäle angeschlossen werden. Zur ganzteiligen Ein- und Ausbringung der HWE sollen ausreichend groß dimensionierte Tor-/Türanlagen errichtet werden. Der Umfang der Ausschreibung umfasst vollumfänglich alle Leistungen, die für den Ersatz der eingangs beschriebenen Heißwassererzeuger zu betriebsfertigen Neuanlagen notwendig sind. Dazu gehören die Planung und das Detail-Engineering (Bau, Mechanik und Elektro-/Leittechnik), der Rückbau bestehender Altanlagen (inkl. Störkantenbeseitigung), die Lieferung, Montage und Verrohrung (wasser- und rauchgasseitig) der neuen Kessel inklusive der für den Betrieb notwendigen Ausrüstung (Messtechnik, Armaturen, Pumpen, Gasregelstrecke, Kesselsteuerschrank usw.) sowie die Inbetriebnahme der Kessel. Alle neu installierten Komponenten müssen hinsichtlich ihrer Bedienung- und Wartungsbereiche leicht zugänglich sein bzw. leicht zugänglich gemacht oder bedient werden können. Sollte dafür Stahlbaubühnen/-podeste umgebaut bzw. neu notwendig werden ist dies ebenfalls im Leistungsumfang des AN. Die Erfüllung aller gültigen Richtlinien, Gesetzen, Vorschriften und Normen werden für den eingangs beschriebenen Leistungsumfang des AN werden vorausgesetzt.

title: Germany – Urban environmental development planning – 10012255-Short Term Expert Support on Sustainable and Inclusive Mobility in Colombia
description: ProMOVIS II, implemented by the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH on behalf of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ), supports Colombian cities in strengthening their capacities to deliver public transport systems that better serve their populations. Colombia has committed to ambitious climate targets under its Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs), requiring a 51% reduction in projected emissions by 2030. The transport sector accounts for approximately 45% of energy related GHG emissions nationwide, making the decarbonization of urban transport one of the country's most impactful mitigation opportunities. Despite ongoing efforts, the integration of public transport systems at local and regional levels remains insufficient, affected by the lasting effects of the pandemic, financing gaps, low digitalization, and early stage regional integration, particularly critical in metropolitan regions with high intermunicipal commuting, such as Valle del Cauca. Within this context, ProMOVIS II concentrates technical cooperation efforts on strengthening public transportation, incorporating a regional integration perspective and initially focusing its actions on Valle del Cauca. The objective is that public transport in selected Colombian cities is more integrated, inclusive and environmentally friendly, pursued through three outcomes: (1) number of people benefiting from newly created or improved public transport; (2) funds secured by selected cities to finance environmentally friendly, integrated public transport projects; and (3) number of bus operators and transport authorities that assess that professionals trained in green jobs training formats contribute positively to integrated, inclusive and environmentally friendly public transport. Through technical assistance, financing-related support, and knowledge exchange, ProMOVIS II addresses the institutional, organizational and operational challenges that limit the effective integration and sustainability of public transport systems, working closely with national and local governments, transport authorities and other stakeholders to strengthen local capacities and develop solutions that are replicable, scalable and sustainable over time.

Es handelt sich um einen großen, aus mehreren Bauteilen zusammengesetzten Baukörper mit zentraler Empfangshalle, an die ein zweigeschossiger Ostflügel und ein ebenfalls zweigeschossiger Westflügel angrenzen, in denen ehemalige Diensträume, Wartesäle verschiedener Klassen, Räume für Post, Zoll und Polizei sowie Wohnräume des Vorstehers untergebracht waren. Die Bereiche der ehemaligen Wartesäle und des Westflügels sind unterkellert. Das Gebäude wurde in dunkelrotem Backstein errichtet, die einzelnen Bauteile sind mit Walm- und Satteldächern versehen. Die Fassaden sind durch Lisenen und Gesimse zurückhaltend gegliedert. Besonders hervorgehoben ist die Giebelseite mit dem Haupteingang durch Verwendung dekorativer Bachsteinverbände sowie ein lebhaft gestaltetes Giebelgesims. Im Zuge dieses Bauvorhabens wird das Bahnhofsgebäude grundlegend saniert, umgebaut und erweitert.

title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – FFH-Monitoring Wildkatze Berichtsperiode 2025-2030
description: In der FFH-Richtlinie werden für die Europäische Union insgesamt 231 Lebensraumtypen (Anhang I, davon 93 in Deutschland vorkommend) und rund 1000 Arten und Unterarten (Anhang II, davon 143 in Deutschland vorkommend) von gemeinschaftlichem Interesse aufgelistet, für die ein System vernetzter Schutzgebiete eingerichtet werden muss. Gemäß Artikel 17 der FFH-Richtlinie sind die Mitgliedsstaaten dazu verpflichtet, der EU-Kommission alle 6 Jahre einen nationalen Bericht zum Stand der Umsetzung der Richtlinie zu übermitteln und darin die Erhaltungszustände aller auf den Anhängen verzeichneten Lebensraumtypen (LRT) und Arten zu bewerten. In Deutschland erfolgt die Erstellung des Berichtes überwiegend auf der Grundlage von Daten der Länder, die auf bundesweit einheitlichen Erhebungsmethoden basieren. Auf der Grundlage der Berichte der Mitgliedsstaaten erstellt die EU-Kommission einen Gemeinschafts-bericht. Der Artikel 11 der FFH-Richtlinie verpflichtet die Mitgliedsstaaten zur Überwachung des Erhaltungszustandes (Monitoring) der FFH-Schutzgüter (LRT (Anhang I) und Arten (Anhänge II, IV und V)). In einem mehrjährigen Abstimmungsprozess haben Bund und Länder sich auf ein bundesweites Vorgehen beim FFH-Monitoring geeinigt. Für das Monitoring werden auf Bundesebene die Anzahl der Stichprobenflächen (SPF) je Schutzgut (LRT oder Art) auf die Bundesländer (Bundesstichprobe) verteilt. Je Schutzgut werden dabei max. 63 SPF je biogeografischer Region innerhalb und außerhalb von FFH-Gebieten verteilt, bei weniger Vorkommen eines Schutzgutes als 63 je biogeografischer Region werden alle Vorkommen in einem Totalzensus (TZ) überprüft.

title: Germany – General management consultancy services – 10035189-Advice on implementation of AfCFTA Digital Trade Protocol and technical inputs to related reforms; facilitation and development of partnerships with the private sector on digital trade
description: The project "Pan-African e-Commerce Initiative 3 - Boosting African Digital Trade" (PeCI 3) is a regional technical cooperation project implemented by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) in the context of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA). The project aims to strengthen an enabling environment for cross-border digital trade in Africa, with a particular focus on micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs), including women-led businesses. PeCI 3 contributes to the BMZ"s core area "Sustainable Economic Development, Training and Employment" and supports it"s digital policy and Africa Strategy through the promotion of inclusive digital trade ecosystems, and public-private cooperation. The project builds on the achievements and partnerships established under the previous phases (PeCI 1 and PeCI 2). Earlier phases supported MSMEs in adopting e-commerce solutions and digital sales channels, strengthened intermediary organisations providing training and advisory services, facilitated public-private exchange on digital trade issues and contributed to regional approaches related to e-commerce, digital payments, consumer protection and electronic transactions. The project also strengthened cooperation with the East African Community (EAC), the Smart Africa Alliance (SAA) and the AfCFTA Secretariat. PeCI 3 supports implementation of the AfCFTA Digital Trade Protocol (DTP), adopted by the African Union in 2024, by strengthening structures, processes and cooperation mechanisms required for cross-border digital trade. The project addresses barriers affecting MSME participation in digital trade, including fragmented regulatory frameworks, limited interoperability of digital payment systems, logistics and last-mile delivery challenges, gaps in online consumer protection and limited coordination between public and private actors. Particular attention is given to barriers affecting women"s participation in digital trade ecosystems. The project operates at pan-African, regional and national levels and combines technical advisory services, stakeholder consultations, public-private dialogue formats and capacity development measures. Activities include support for implementation of selected DTP chapters, facilitation of cross-border exchange on best practices, development of cooperation models between private-sector actors and intermediary organisations, and support for gender-sensitive approaches to digital entrepreneurship and MSME support services. Environmental sustainability is integrated as a cross-cutting topic, including approaches related to sustainable packaging and resource-efficient logistics. The project is implemented in cooperation with public, private and regional stakeholders in selected AfCFTA countries, particularly Ghana and Kenya, as well as with the EAC. Lead executing agencies are the Ministry of Finance in Ghana, the Ministry of Investments, Trade and Industry (MITI) in Kenya and the EAC Secretariat. Additional partners include the AfCFTA Secretariat, the Smart Africa Secretariat, chambers of commerce, business and e-commerce associations, payment service providers, logistics companies, innovation hubs and women"s business networks. PeCI 3 further aims to strengthen cooperation between African, German and European private-sector actors to promote cross-border digital trade and MSME participation. The project cooperates with business associations, e-commerce platforms, logistics and payment providers, chambers of commerce and innovation actors, including bevh, AHKs and African e-commerce associations. Cooperation with UNCTAD, ITC and initiatives supported by the European Union and the World Bank further strengthens synergies and regional outreach. The project is scheduled to run until June 2028.

Als wissenschaftliches Institut des Bundes für Forschung auf den Gebieten Gewässerkunde, Wasserwirtschaft, Gewässerschutz sowie Ökologie berät sie Bundesministerien und deren nachgeordnete Dienststellen. Die BfG berät gleichermaßen die Behörden der Wasserstraßenund Schifffahrtsverwaltung (WSV) hinsichtlich der Planung, des Aus- und Neubaus sowie des Betriebes und der Unterhaltung der Bundeswasserstraßen (BWStr). Ergänzende Informationen sind auf der Internetseite http://www.bafg.de verfügbar. Im Auftrag von BMV und WSV erstellt die BfG auch Vorhersagemodelle und -systeme für die Binnenwasserstraßen, pflegt und entwickelt diese Systeme kontinuierlich weiter. Darüber hinaus erstellt und veröffentlicht die BfG operationell wie präoperationell Vorhersagen für ausgewählte Wasserstraßen. Die bestehenden sowie zukünftigen Vorhersagesysteme des Bundes für die Binnenwasserstraßen basieren auf der Software Delft-FEWS. Aktuell werden mit dem Delft-FEWS System bei der BfG Wasserstand- und Abflussvorhersagen für die Gebiete von Rhein, Donau, Elbe, Eder, Weser und Nord-Ostsee-Kanal erstellt. Hinzu kommen Eisvorhersagen für Mittelland- und Elbe-Seitenkanal sowie die Aufbereitung hydrometeorologischer Mess- und Vorhersagedaten für alle deutschen Flussgebiete inkl. ihrer ausländischen Anteile. Das System ist entsprechend umfangreich mit aktuell über 1000 Konfigurationsdateien (ca. 540 Workflow-Files und ca. 900 ModuleConfig- Files). Konkret in der Planung befinden sich zudem ein Vorhersagesystem für die Eider und die Erweiterung des Vorhersagehorizontes an Rhein und Elbe auf bis zu 6 Monate. Letzteres ist aktuell Forschungsgegenstand und wird zukünftig in das Vorhersagesystem überführt. Zur Unterstützung der Arbeiten der BfG bei der Aktualisierung und Weiterentwicklung der Delft-FEWS-Konfiguration sind die im Folgenden skizzierten Tätigkeiten durch einen Auftragnehmer im Zeitraum 2026 - 2030 zu erbringen. Um die mit dem BfG-Personal engverzahnte und vielfach iterativ durchzuführende Bearbeitung fachlich zu realisieren sowie aus technischen Rahmenbedingungen bei der BfG, kann es in Einzelaufträgen erforderlich sein, dass auch Leistungen in nennenswertem Umfang beim Auftraggeber am Dienstsitz der BfG in Koblenz zu erbringen sind. Die Pflicht zur Anwesenheit bei der BfG wird auf das fachlich wie technisch erforderliche Mindestmaß reduziert. Zur Erfüllung diesbezüglicher Anforderungen werden von einem im Rahmen der EVB-IT Rahmenvereinbarung von IT-Dienstleistungen zu beauftragendem Dienstleister die in dieser Tätigkeitsbeschreibung definierten Leistungen erforderlich. Die jeweils zu erbringenden Leistungen in den unterschiedlichen Leistungspunkten werden in Einzelaufträgen detailliert spezifiziert (Tätigkeiten, Auftragsvolumen, Fristen) und werden nach Aufwand abgerechnet. Folgende Leistungen (Personen-Stunden) werden schätzungsweise in den aufgeführten Jahren benö-tigt. Die genannten Leistungsmengen spiegeln den aktuellen geschätzten Bedarf wider. Die Schät-zung, wie viele Stunden der Delft-FEWS-Konfiguration zwingend am Dienstsitz des AG zu erbringen sind, beläuft sich auf 1.100. Eine Mindestabnahme ergibt sich aus diesen Angaben nicht. Das Höchst-volumen (maximale Abnahmemenge) des Rahmenvertrages für die gesamte Laufzeit beträgt 2500 Stunden. Die ausführliche Beschreibung der zu erbringenden Leistungen entnehmen Sie bitte den Vergabeunterlagen.

title: Germany – Business services: law, marketing, consulting, recruitment, printing and security – 10032182-Building the capacities of smallholder farmers on agriculture best practices, and climate smart agriculture in Upper Egypt
description: The Agricultural Innovation Project Phase II (AIP II) is an Egyptian-German Technical Cooperation project commissioned by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and implemented by Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH in cooperation with the Egyptian Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation (MALR). The project runs until the end of 2029 and aims to increase the income and resilience of smallholder farmers and rural entrepreneurs in Upper Egypt through market-oriented agricultural innovations and climate-resilient production practices. Under co-financing by the Swiss Development Cooperation (SDC/DEZA) and the Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO), AIP II contributes to the LAND-at-Scale (LAS) programme, particularly through activities related to Participatory Land-Use Consolidation (LUC), climate resilience and inclusive business models. The intervention focuses on strengthening agricultural productivity, climate resilience, market integration and the provision of improved services to smallholder farmers. The assignment covers the governorates of Beni Suef, Minya, Asyut and Sohag and targets selected value chains, including medicinal and aromatic plants (MAPs) such as basil, chamomile, mint, marjoram, fennel, anise and geranium, as well as onions, garlic, tomatoes, sesame, soybeans and green beans. The assignment forms part of AIP II Output 1, which focuses on enhancing the climate resilience and productivity of smallholder farmers. It aims to strengthen the capacities of approximately 9,000 smallholder farmers and 200 rural stakeholders, including agricultural extension services, cooperatives, agriculture-related enterprises, community leaders and young professionals. A key feature of the intervention is the application of a Living Lab approach. The Living Lab provides a multi-stakeholder framework for co-creating, testing, validating and scaling agricultural innovations under real-life conditions. It brings together farmers, multipliers, community leaders, research institutions and public and private sector actors. The approach is complemented by Farmer Field School (FFS) methods, which provide a practical and farmer-centred learning and experimentation tool within the broader Living Lab framework. The conceptualisation and transition phases of the Living Lab approach are implemented by the Leibniz Centre for Agricultural Landscape Research (ZALF). The present assignment covers the subsequent scaling-up phase. The selected service provider will implement the validated solutions through Interactive Demo Plots, field visits, training and knowledge exchange, while supporting inclusive business models and Land-Use Consolidation. The overall intervention is designed to strengthen the adoption and scaling of climate-smart agriculture (CSA), Good Agricultural Practices (GAP), post-harvest practices and market-oriented solutions, thereby contributing to more productive, sustainable and climate-resilient agricultural systems in Upper Egypt.

Zu Gebäude 082 besteht eine bauliche Verbindung über das Untergeschoss und das Erdgeschoss. Gebäude 080 schließt ebenfalls im Untergeschoss, Erdgeschoss und im 1. Obergeschoss an die Neurochirurgie an. description: Die GVE Grundstücksverwaltung Stadt Essen GmbH (GVE) setzt das Projekt für die Stadt Essen um. Projektaufgabe und Projektziel ist die Generalplanung und Umsetzung eines Neubaus einer Einfachturnhalle für den Abzweig Maria-Wächtler-Gymnasium in Essen-Rüttenscheid. Eine Machbarkeitsstudie inkl. Bestandsbewertung hat stattgefunden. Daraufhin hat der Rat der Stadt Essen die weitere Planung eines Neubaus der Turnhalle beschlossen. Der Abbruch ist nicht Bestandteil des Leistungsbilds. Aufgabe ist die Erbringung, sofern beauftragt, aller mangelfreien Planungs-, Koordinations- und Überwachungsleistungen, die den vertragsgerechten Neubau ermöglichen. Hinzu kommen Leistungen der Objektbetreuung. Das Gesamtvolumen des Projektes (ohne Abbruch der Bestandsturnhalle) wird grob, mit Kostenstand zum 15.02.2026, auf rund 4 Mio. EUR netto beziffert, für die Kostengruppen 200 - 600 nach DIN 276. Diese Kostenermittlung stellt aufgrund der erst noch zu erarbeitenden Planungsschritte keine Basis für ein Auftragsversprechen dar. Der Generalplanungsauftrag umfasst Planungs- und Ingenieurleistungen betreffend Leistungsbilder / Leistungsbereiche gemäß HOAI und AHO: - Gebäude und Innenräume - §§ 33 ff. und Anlage 10 HOAI - Freianlagen - §§ 38 ff. und Anlage 11 HOAI - Tragwerksplanung - §§ 49 ff. und Anlage 14 HOAI - Technische Gebäudeausrüstung - §§ 53 ff. und Anlage 15 HOAI o Abwasser-, Wasser, Gasanlagen o Wärmeversorgungsanlagen o Lufttechnische Anlagen o Starkstromanlagen inkl. Photovoltaik o Fernmelde- und informationstechnische Anlagen o Nutzungsspezifische und verfahrenstechnische Anlagen o Gebäudeautomation - Bauphysik - gemäß Anlage 1.2 HOAI o Wärmeschutz und Energiebilanzierung o Bauakustik (Schallschutz) o Raumakustik - Brandschutz - gemäß AHO Heft 17 - Barrierefrei-Planer gemäß AHO Heft 40 - Nachhaltigkeitskoordinator (BNB) Ein Planungsteam bzw. Generalplaner soll die Leistungen, ggf. unter Einbindung der entsprechenden Fachplaner als Nachunternehmer (Unterauftragnehmer), erbringen. Die Beauftragung erfolgt stufenweise. Das Projekt soll durch das Förderprogramm NRW- Infrastrukturgesetz 2025-2036 finanziert werden. Die Förderkriterien sind bei der Planung und Umsetzung des Projektes entsprechend einzuhalten. Die Einzelheiten sind insbesondere dem Leitfaden sowie der Leistungsbeschreibung (Anlage B.3) mit Anlagen zu entnehmen. Die Leistungsbeschreibung stellt den aktuellen Planungsstand dar, der sich im Laufe des Vergabeverfahrens und insbesondere während der Ausführung der Leistungen weiterentwickeln und verändern kann.

Au moment de la rédaction des conditions du présent marché, l’administration n’est pas en mesure de définir avec précision les quantités de fournitures dont elle aura besoin. En conséquence, les quantités présumées indiquées dans le présent cahier spécial des charges régissant le présent marché sont à titre purement indicatif et elles n’engagent nullement l’administration. Le marché est attribué au(x) soumissionnaire(s) dont l’offre est régulière et économiquement la plus avantageuse. Le classement établi lors de l’analyse des offres déterminera l’ordre de recours aux fournisseurs dans le cadre d'un système en cascade. Les commandes sont d’abord adressées au fournisseur le mieux classé. En cas d’indisponibilité d’un article ou de délai de livraison non respecté, la commande est passée au fournisseur suivant dans le classement. L’indisponibilité devra être confirmée par écrit par le fournisseur concerné dans un délai de 24h ouvrables. Les fournitures seront livrées au siège de la slsp. Le délai standard de livraison doit être indiqué et ne pourra excéder 48 heures ouvrables sauf exception. La livraison s’effectue sur base de bon de commande signé. Une vérification qualitative et quantitative sera effectuée à la réception. Le marché peut être reconduit tacitement 3 fois. Lieu de livraison : 5503 Sorinnes rue du Saxophone 97 (ou, à titre exceptionnel, directement au sein du patrimoine de la slsp)

title: Sweden – Industrial machinery – Deep Reaction Ion Etcher (DRIE)
description: Myfab Uppsala aims at purchasing a Deep Reaction Ion Etcher (DRIE). The purpose of the tool is to transfer patterns defined by e.g., photo- and electron beam lithography covering the pattens size range from all substrate range down to a few nanometres. The system will be used by many operators in a university laboratory environment. It must be easy to use and be insensitive to frequent change of process between batches. The processes include broad range of etching capability: low to high etch rate, wafer dicing, high uniformity, high open area, high aspect ratio, and nanometre scale. The system is intended for etching of silicon as well as other materials compatible with silicon etching, with both photoresist resins and hard masks for patterning.

title: (EAR048) Repair Fire Alarm System Eareckson Air Station Facilities
description: **06 NOV 2026 Update** See the attached file �EAR048_Industry Questions and GOV Response, 06 NOV 2026� for U.S. Government (USG) responses to industry questions. Please continue to submit questions to the Point of Contact (POC) listed below. The USG will post responses on a weekly basis. **End of 06 NOV 2026 Update ** **30 OCT 2026 Update** See the attached file �EAR048_Industry Questions and GOV Response, 30 OCT 2026� for U.S. Government (USG) responses to industry questions. Please continue to submit questions to the Point of Contact (POC) listed below. The USG will post responses on a weekly basis. **End of 30 OCT 2026 Update ** REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) / MARKET INTELLIGENCE NOTICE Notice: This is a Request for Information (RFI) for market intelligence and for informational purposes only. This announcement does not constitute a Solicitation or a Request for Proposal (RFP), and no solicitation is currently available. Participation in this RFI is strictly voluntary. The Government will not be obligated to award any agreement or contract because of this RFI, nor will it reimburse respondents for any costs associated with the preparation or submission of information. Submitting a response will not affect a firm�s ability to submit a proposal should a formal solicitation be issued in the future. NAICS Code: 236220 � Commercial and Institutional Building Construction (Note: While Other Transaction Authority is not subject to FAR-based small business regulations, this NAICS code is provided for market research to help the Government understand the size and demographics of the interested industrial base.) Small Business Size Standard: $45 Million PROJECT OVERVIEW The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Alaska District, has a requirement for the site-wide repair and replacement of fire alarm systems at Eareckson Air Station (Shemya Island, Alaska). The project will replace aging and non-compliant fire alarm systems across multiple facilities to meet current UFC 3-600-01, NFPA 72, and life-safety requirements. Existing systems are outdated or non-functional, creating risk to personnel and mission on this remote installation. The Government is now pursuing a wireless (or hybrid wireless) fire alarm architecture that significantly reduces or eliminates the need for extensive buried fiber optic infrastructure, thereby addressing the primary cost driver while achieving full code compliance. Key project components include: � Demolition of existing fire alarm control panels, initiating devices, notification appliances, conduit, and wiring across affected buildings � Installation of a new wireless/hybrid addressable fire alarm system, including wireless devices, gateways/repeaters for campus-wide RF coverage, limited residual hard-wired elements only where essential, and integration with supervisory/monitoring capabilities � RF coverage analysis, specialty detection in hazardous (Class I) locations associated with fuel systems, cybersecurity compliance, multi-shift training, testing, commissioning, and phased turnover � Phased execution by building or geographic area to accommodate remote-island logistics and minimize operational impact Estimated Acquisition Magnitude: Between $27M and $33M Planned Acquisition Strategy: Anticipated to utilize Progressive Design Build via Other Transaction Authority (OTA) The Alaska District is conducting market intelligence to assess industry capability and interest in supporting this effort utilizing an Other Transaction (OT) Agreement under the authority of 10 U.S.C. � 2808a, Facility Construction or Repair: Transactions Other Than Contracts and Grants. This authority is distinct from the Department of Defense prototype OT authorities commonly associated with 10 U.S.C. � 4021 and 4022. This authority is intended for military construction and repair projects that involve testing and experimentation associated with new and emergent construction technologies to achieve potential benefits such as enhanced mission resilience, improved installation support, or cost and schedule reduction. The anticipated delivery method is Progressive Design-Build. Design and Pre-Construction Services - The OT Awardee shall assist the Government collaboratively in advancing the wireless/hybrid fire alarm design, performing RF coverage analysis and site investigations, supporting the UFC waiver process, validating and refining project requirements, and developing progressively more detailed open-book cost and schedule information. Design is expected to advance from approximately 0�15% at award to an agreed interim milestone (target approximately 65%) sufficient for reliable Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP) development. Final Design and Construction - Upon reaching an agreed-upon level of design, the Awardee will propose a Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP) or Firm-Fixed-Price for final design and construction. If the price is accepted and required funding/approvals (including UFC waiver status) are in place, the Government will authorize Phase 2 execution via modification. Construction is expected to be authorized in staggered packages by building or geographic area to allow early turnover of priority facilities. If a fair and reasonable price cannot be agreed upon, or if other conditions prevent proceeding, the Government retains an �off-ramp� to complete the project via alternative methods while retaining rights to the design developed during Phase 1. title: Request for Information _ Creation of The United States Space Academy
description: On Aug. 28, 2026, President Donald J. Trump issued Executive Order (E.O.) 14423, Establishing the United States Space Academy. To answer that call, the United States Space Academy (USSA) is envisioned as a NASA-led, civilian Federal academic institution that combines rigorous technical education with disciplined leadership development, civic responsibility, and a lasting commitment to public service. The Academy will prepare future scientists, engineers, astronauts, pilots, operators, entrepreneurs, civil servants, warfighters, and other leaders to advance American interests across the aerospace sector. Through this Request for Information (RFI), NASA invites each State to submit one official State-sponsored response prepared by a �Responding Entity� and coordinated and formally endorsed by a State Selecting Official. The Governor must designate both the Responding Entity and the State Selecting Official in writing. The response should provide information to support NASA�s assessment of potential locations and operating solutions for the United States Space Academy (USSA). That assessment will inform NASA�s recommendation to the Commission. NASA�s objectives for this announcement are to: Identify potential locations for the permanent establishment of the USSA campus, including a groundbreaking no later than 2027. Identify interim solutions that may allow the USSA to begin instruction in 2028 and facilitate a smooth transition to a permanent campus by 2031. Explore the estimated costs of establishing the USSA and potential state, local, and other non-Federal partnerships that could support its establishment. Information obtained through this RFI will be used by NASA and the Commission to develop the recommended process for selecting the Academy�s permanent physical location, which will be reported to the President for decision. A separate announcement for formal proposals may be issued at a later date. PLEASE NOTE: If there are issues with file submission please email hq-nasa-ussa@mail.nasa.gov. We will respond and provide a box link to upload files. UPDATES MADE AS OF 10.2.26: Question and Answers Document attached. UPDATES MADE AS OF 10.7.26: Updated Question and Answers Document attached. UPDATES MADE AS OF 10.9.26: RFI extended until November 16, 2026.

description: 52.219-27� Notice of Set-Aside for, or Sole-Source Award to, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Concerns Eligible Under the SDVOSB Program. (a) Definition. Service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB) concern means a small business concern (1)(i) Not less than 51 percent of which is owned and controlled by one or more service-disabled veterans or, in the case of any publicly owned business, not less than 51 percent of the stock of which is owned by one or more service-disabled veterans; and (ii) The management and daily business operations of which are controlled by one or more service-disabled veterans or, in the case of a service-disabled veteran with permanent and severe disability, the spouse or permanent caregiver of such veteran; or (2) A small business concern eligible under the SDVOSB Program in accordance with 13 CFR part 128 (see FAR 19.106). (3) Service-disabled veteran, as used in this definition, means a veteran as defined in 38 U.S.C. 101(2), with a disability that is service-connected, as defined in 38 U.S.C. 101(16) and who is registered in the Beneficiary Identification and Records Locator Subsystem, or successor system that is maintained by the Department of Veterans Affairs Veterans Benefits Administration, as a service-disabled veteran. Service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB) concern eligible under the SDVOSB Program means an SDVOSB concern that is designated in the System for Award Management (SAM) as certified by the Small Business Administration (SBA) in accordance with 13 CFR 128.300. Service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB) Program means a program that authorizes contracting officers to limit competition, including award on a sole-source basis, to SDVOSB concerns eligible under the SDVOSB Program. (b) Applicability. This clause applies only to (1) Contracts that have been set aside for, or awarded on a sole-source basis to, SDVOSB concerns eligible under the SDVOSB Program; (2) Part or parts of a multiple-award contract that have been set aside for SDVOSB concerns eligible under the SDVOSB Program; and (3) Orders set aside for SDVOSB concerns eligible under the SDVOSB Program, under multiple-award contracts as described in 8.4 and 16.5. (c) General.(1) Offers are solicited only from concerns designated in SAM as SDVOSB concerns certified by SBA. Offers received from concerns that are not SDVOSB concerns certified by SBA will not be considered. (2) Any award resulting from this solicitation will be made only to a concern designated in SAM as an SDVOSB certified by SBA. (d) A joint venture may be considered an SDVOSB concern if the managing partner of the joint venture complies with the criteria defined in paragraph (a) of this clause and 13 CFR 128.402. (e) In a joint venture that complies with paragraph (d) of this clause, the SDVOSB party or parties to the joint venture shall perform at least 40 percent of the work performed by the joint venture. Work performed by the SDVOSB party or parties to the joint venture must be more than administrative functions. title: Request for Information _ Creation of The United States Space Academy
description: On Aug. 28, 2026, President Donald J. Trump issued Executive Order (E.O.) 14423, Establishing the United States Space Academy. To answer that call, the United States Space Academy (USSA) is envisioned as a NASA-led, civilian Federal academic institution that combines rigorous technical education with disciplined leadership development, civic responsibility, and a lasting commitment to public service. The Academy will prepare future scientists, engineers, astronauts, pilots, operators, entrepreneurs, civil servants, warfighters, and other leaders to advance American interests across the aerospace sector. Through this Request for Information (RFI), NASA invites each State to submit one official State-sponsored response prepared by a �Responding Entity� and coordinated and formally endorsed by a State Selecting Official. The Governor must designate both the Responding Entity and the State Selecting Official in writing. The response should provide information to support NASA�s assessment of potential locations and operating solutions for the United States Space Academy (USSA). That assessment will inform NASA�s recommendation to the Commission. NASA�s objectives for this announcement are to: Identify potential locations for the permanent establishment of the USSA campus, including a groundbreaking no later than 2027. Identify interim solutions that may allow the USSA to begin instruction in 2028 and facilitate a smooth transition to a permanent campus by 2031. Explore the estimated costs of establishing the USSA and potential state, local, and other non-Federal partnerships that could support its establishment. Information obtained through this RFI will be used by NASA and the Commission to develop the recommended process for selecting the Academy�s permanent physical location, which will be reported to the President for decision. A separate announcement for formal proposals may be issued at a later date. PLEASE NOTE: If there are issues with file submission please email hq-nasa-ussa@mail.nasa.gov. We will respond and provide a box link to upload files. UPDATES MADE AS OF 11.2.26: Additional Question and Answers Document attached. title: (EAR048) Repair Fire Alarm System Eareckson Air Station Facilities
description: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) / MARKET INTELLIGENCE NOTICE Notice: This is a Request for Information (RFI) for market intelligence and for informational purposes only. This announcement does not constitute a Solicitation or a Request for Proposal (RFP), and no solicitation is currently available. Participation in this RFI is strictly voluntary. The Government will not be obligated to award any agreement or contract because of this RFI, nor will it reimburse respondents for any costs associated with the preparation or submission of information. Submitting a response will not affect a firm�s ability to submit a proposal should a formal solicitation be issued in the future. NAICS Code: 236220 � Commercial and Institutional Building Construction (Note: While Other Transaction Authority is not subject to FAR-based small business regulations, this NAICS code is provided for market research to help the Government understand the size and demographics of the interested industrial base.) Small Business Size Standard: $45 Million PROJECT OVERVIEW The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Alaska District, has a requirement for the site-wide repair and replacement of fire alarm systems at Eareckson Air Station (Shemya Island, Alaska). The project will replace aging and non-compliant fire alarm systems across multiple facilities to meet current UFC 3-600-01, NFPA 72, and life-safety requirements. Existing systems are outdated or non-functional, creating risk to personnel and mission on this remote installation. The Government is now pursuing a wireless (or hybrid wireless) fire alarm architecture that significantly reduces or eliminates the need for extensive buried fiber optic infrastructure, thereby addressing the primary cost driver while achieving full code compliance. Key project components include: � Demolition of existing fire alarm control panels, initiating devices, notification appliances, conduit, and wiring across affected buildings � Installation of a new wireless/hybrid addressable fire alarm system, including wireless devices, gateways/repeaters for campus-wide RF coverage, limited residual hard-wired elements only where essential, and integration with supervisory/monitoring capabilities � RF coverage analysis, specialty detection in hazardous (Class I) locations associated with fuel systems, cybersecurity compliance, multi-shift training, testing, commissioning, and phased turnover � Phased execution by building or geographic area to accommodate remote-island logistics and minimize operational impact Estimated Acquisition Magnitude: Between $27M and $33M Planned Acquisition Strategy: Anticipated to utilize Progressive Design Build via Other Transaction Authority (OTA) The Alaska District is conducting market intelligence to assess industry capability and interest in supporting this effort utilizing an Other Transaction (OT) Agreement under the authority of 10 U.S.C. � 2808a, Facility Construction or Repair: Transactions Other Than Contracts and Grants. This authority is distinct from the Department of Defense prototype OT authorities commonly associated with 10 U.S.C. � 4021 and 4022. This authority is intended for military construction and repair projects that involve testing and experimentation associated with new and emergent construction technologies to achieve potential benefits such as enhanced mission resilience, improved installation support, or cost and schedule reduction. The anticipated delivery method is Progressive Design-Build. Design and Pre-Construction Services - The OT Awardee shall assist the Government collaboratively in advancing the wireless/hybrid fire alarm design, performing RF coverage analysis and site investigations, supporting the UFC waiver process, validating and refining project requirements, and developing progressively more detailed open-book cost and schedule information. Design is expected to advance from approximately 0�15% at award to an agreed interim milestone (target approximately 65%) sufficient for reliable Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP) development. Final Design and Construction - Upon reaching an agreed-upon level of design, the Awardee will propose a Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP) or Firm-Fixed-Price for final design and construction. If the price is accepted and required funding/approvals (including UFC waiver status) are in place, the Government will authorize Phase 2 execution via modification.
